description.text: The modification pack (改造包) came in the Happy Set Lucario & Greninja & Zamazenta & Mabosstiff of 16 May 2025. Its ten cards are for a player who lost a game to add to their deck before the next. It holds two of six Pokémon, three of six Supporters, three of six Items and two of five Pokémon Tools, never the same card twice. One of the Pokémon, Kangaskhan ex, turns up 3.1% of the time; the other five Pokémon are made in equal numbers, and so are the cards within each of the other kinds. Its 23 cards are numbered out of 23.
